# requireValidSlideId

<link-summary>Returns the value as a slide id, or throws.</link-summary>

<web-summary>requireValidSlideId() — Returns the value as a slide id, or throws. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/slide</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function requireValidSlideId(
  value: unknown,
  message: string = "Expected a valid slide id."
): string;
```

Letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, at least one of them. Slide ids are short — `p1` is a perfectly ordinary one — so no minimum length is imposed.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter                                               | Type      | Description                                                   |
| :------------------------------------------------------ | :-------- | :------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `value`                                                 | `unknown` | The value to validate.                                        |
| `message` _(optional)_ `= "Expected a valid slide id."` | `string`  | The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted. |

## Returns

`string` — the same value, typed as a slide id.

## Throws

| Exception                  | Condition                    |
| :------------------------- | :--------------------------- |
| `IllegalArgumentException` | the value is not a slide id. |

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
requireValidSlideId("p1"); // => "p1"
requireValidSlideId("SLIDES_api123"); // => "SLIDES_api123"
requireValidSlideId("has space"); // throws IllegalArgumentException
requireValidSlideId(""); // throws IllegalArgumentException
```
